description: This file defines classes and methods for managing analytic default distributions, integrating with invoice lines, stock pickings, and sale order lines in an Odoo (OpenERP) module. It includes data models, business logic for retrieving analytic accounts, and overrides for invoice and sale order processing.

classes.name: account_analytic_default
classes.description: Data model for storing analytic distribution defaults, with methods to retrieve the best matching record based on criteria.

classes.name: account_invoice_line
classes.description: Extension of invoice line to set analytic account based on default distribution.

classes.name: stock_picking
classes.description: Extension of stock picking to determine analytic account for invoice creation.

classes.name: sale_order_line
classes.description: Extension of sale order line to assign analytic account during invoice creation.

methods.name: account_get
methods.description: Retrieve the most appropriate analytic default record based on product, partner, user, and date.

methods.name: product_id_change
methods.description: Update invoice line with analytic account when product is changed.

methods.name: _get_account_analytic_invoice
methods.description: Determine analytic account for stock picking invoice based on defaults.

methods.name: invoice_line_create
methods.description: Create invoice lines and assign analytic accounts based on defaults.
